exa-api.description: Exa API key (https://dashboard.exa.ai). The ${SECRET:exa-api} marker lands in the x-api-key header as a literal placeholder; the OneCLI gateway proxy swaps it for the real key on outbound HTTPS to mcp.exa.ai. The marker also makes deploy-mcp GATE the exa stanza — it is skipped for any bot that does not have exa-api bound (so exa never deploys to unbound bots, avoiding the AgentShield external-URL HIGH finding). Shared key across the fleet; per-bot binding preserves isolation.
